task_title: Fix Floor 1 to Floor 2 player transition

plan_review.notes: Red-team retained the fresh-world/value-snapshot design but made the contract explicit. Rejected in-place world mutation (stale ECS/scenario leakage), localStorage/global singleton (second nondeterministic source of truth), ad hoc URL payload state (serialization/identity/seed loss), and synthetic-only direct-start testing (would not prove production transport). Adopted a shared value-only carry-over module, distinct direct-start vs carry-over player entry policy, capture after Floor 1 finalization, restore before first Floor 2 sync, correct settlement-then-Broker semantics, and browser transport plus chained deterministic coverage.

rounds.notes: Found absolute frame timestamps and split SkillState objects; both fixed with rebasing/shared references. Suggested Broker-chain completion test was adjudicated out of scope because the hard gate is starter-objective exposure.

Found host-composed options would be dropped; resolved with explicit recomposeFloorTransitionOptions wiring. Claude Opus 4.8 final adjudication inspected the fix and reported no blockers at the two-round cap.

Adjudicated valid: cooldown/timed-modifier frame rebasing, shared SkillState identity, and queued Phaser restart-data lifecycle. Broker-chain completion and duplicate-stair tests were outside the approved hard gate; overlapping alias finding deduplicated.

Direct source evidence accepted exact holder-EID parsing/remapping for v2 skill/ability modifiers and host option recomposition. Claude Opus 4.8 adjudicated the final staged diff clean with no high-confidence blockers.
